title: Amarite Left Hand Fix
description: Fixes a bug in the mod Amarite that makes the 'lefty' option be buggy
body:
This texture pack fixes a bug in Amarite where the lefthand sprites dont work like they should. Nothing else to explain, thats all it does LOL

Here are some images:
![accumulation actually working in the left hand](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/41345ea1de4c81e64dd77d803f6a91fec786ec94.png)
![Blocking actually working in the left hand](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f90cf673d1af612993de72d7f1f9fb5fc63d870f.png)

If you have any questions, contact me via discord: @fishmeister_iii
